in_arabic.name: قيصان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من قيس، يعني الحجم أو المقدار
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قيصان مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ق-ي-س، والذي يعني الحجم أو المقدار، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية أن القيس هو التقدير والقياس، ومنه قوله تعالى: {وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ}، الآية 8 من سورة الرعد، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأحاديث النبوية

in_urdu.name: قیصان
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب ہے اندازه یا پیمانہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: قیصان نام عربی زبان کے ق-ی-س جذر سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اندازه یا پیمانہ، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں استعمال ہوا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ رعد میں: {وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ}، اور یہ نام بعض احادیث نبوی میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کا حجم یا مقدار

in_hindi.name: क़ैसन
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है माप या परिमाण
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ैसन नाम अरबी भाषा के क़-य-स मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है माप या परिमाण, यह नाम कुरआन में प्रयोग हुआ है, जैसे कि सूरा रअद में: {وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ}, और यह नाम कुछ नबवी हदीसों में भी प्रयोग हुआ है, इसका अर्थ है किसी वस्तु का आकार या मात्रा

in_english.name: Kaisan
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root 'q-ys', meaning measure or quantity
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kaisan originates from the Arabic root 'q-ys', which signifies measure or quantity. This root is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah Ar-Ra'd: {وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ}, and is also found in some Prophetic traditions. The name conveys the meaning of a thing's size or amount, symbolizing balance and proportion in Islamic context. It reflects the attribute of Allah as Al-Qadir, the All-Powerful, who measures and ordains everything

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kaisan" in Islamic culture is believed to convey the qualities of a free and independent spirit. It suggests an individual who is self-reliant, bold, and a confident leader. In history, there have been several prominent Islamic figures with this name, such as the medieval Islamic scholar Ibn Kaisan al-Balkhi, who was known for his philosophical and scientific contributions. This name can be seen as embodying the Islamic values of courage, independence, and intellectual pursuits.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Kaisan" holds deeper significance. It represents a person who is pure in intention and action, striving to live according to the guidance of the Almighty Allah. The name can be understood as a reminder to continually reflect on one's intentions and actions, ensuring they are in line with the divine will. In this way, bearing the name "Kaisan" is a constant reminder of the spiritual journey that each individual undertakes throughout their life. It is a name that inspires individuals to not only seek freedom and independence in their external lives but also strive for inner purity and closeness to Allah.
